title: Guesty Lite Widget Integration Guide
text:
4. Testing
After integrating widgets:

Preview locally: Run quarto preview in the website folder
Check responsiveness: Test on mobile, tablet, and desktop
Test booking flow: Complete a test booking to ensure it works
Verify reviews: Confirm reviews are loading from all connected platforms
